Since the practise was taken over it has gone from bad to worse. 2 weeks to see a Dr, 2 weeks to get a blood test. It's crazy. No duty of care at all. Failing in appropriate medical care, cover. I was left for 5 days without a controlled drug,  this was with me phoning every day and had promises made. Left in acute pain and made to go cold turkey.  It was only with the help of Medsclinic that I got to speak to an out of hours Dr via 111 who gave me a script of 12 tablets to see me through the weekend and then I saw Dawn, a manager , who apologised and made sure it was filled within a few hours and advised on a way to avoid it happening again. There is good and bad but unfortunately if there isn't appropriate staff to sign off on prescriptions AND controlled drugs then that wheel falls off only too readily.
